post.related: Close to this in the archive

stories.title: Running stories
stories.intro: Posts that turned out to follow one another, grouped by what they are about and read back in the order the channel published them.
stories.empty: Stories appear once the archive holds enough posts that follow one another.
stories.pick: Pick a story from the list to read it.

studio.title: Studio
studio.needLogin: Sign in with the Telegram account that administers this channel.
studio.notAdmin: Only channel admins can enter the studio.

home.noBot: Connect a bot in settings before you can publish.
home.teachVoice: Teach the assistant how you write
home.teachVoiceBody: It reads your own posts once, and drafts start sounding like you.

ideas.inboxEmpty: Anything you jot down lands here.
ideas.researchingEmpty: Drag an idea here while you dig into it.
ideas.draftingEmpty: Ideas you have started writing show up here.
ideas.publishedEmpty: Ideas that made it to the channel.
ideas.scheduledEmpty: Ideas whose post is waiting for its time.

drafts.brief: What should this post be about?
drafts.orEmpty: Or start from an empty post
drafts.empty: Nothing written yet. Describe a post above and the assistant will start one.

editor.noBot: No bot is connected yet, so this cannot be sent. Ask the platform admin to add one.
editor.titlePlaceholder: Title — only for your own list, it is not sent

settings.letReaders: Let readers ask questions about your channel
settings.answersFrom: Answers only ever come from your posts, and every claim links back to the original.
settings.voiceBody: Built from your own posts, so AI drafts sound like you rather than like an assistant.
settings.botConnected: Posts are sent by @{bot}, which is connected.
settings.botNoWebhook: Posts are sent by @{bot}, but its webhook is not set up yet.
settings.noBot: No bot is connected yet. Ask the platform admin to add one.
settings.startBot: Press /start in @{bot} once, so it can tell you when a post goes out or fails.
settings.paused: The platform admin has paused this channel: the assistant and background work are stopped until it is resumed.
settings.teamBody: Who can enter the studio. An invited person signs in with Telegram like you do, without having to be a channel admin.
settings.memberIdHint: They can find it by messaging @userinfobot on Telegram.

admin.title: Admin
admin.needLogin: Sign in with an allow-listed Telegram account.

chat.intro: Ask anything about this channel. Answers come only from its posts, with links to the originals.
chat.disabled: The assistant is turned off for this channel.
chat.failed: Could not start a chat session.

research.intro: Ask what you have already covered, where the gaps are, or what to write next. Grounded in your own posts.
research.failed: Could not start a chat session.
research.gaps: What have I not covered lately?
research.covered: What did I publish this month?
research.popular: Which of my posts performed best this year?

stats.title: Statistics
stats.intro: How the channel posts and how it gets read, from the posts held here. Clock-shaped figures use the channel's own time zone.
stats.calendarHint: One square per day. Darker means more posts.
stats.weekdayHourHint: Weekday against hour, in the channel's own time zone.
stats.sourcesHint: External domains the channel sends readers to.
stats.afterIndexingIntro: These come from reading every post, not from counting them — which is why a follower-count service cannot show them.
stats.pending: Waiting on indexing. {done} of {total} posts read so far; this fills in as extraction completes.
stats.themeDrift: What it covered, year by year
stats.themeDriftHint: Each band is a theme; the width is its share of that quarter.

tags.title: The index
tags.intro: Every post is filed under the subjects it covers and the people, bodies and places it names. These groups were built from the channel's own history.
tags.empty: Nothing filed under this group yet.

graph.title: The map
graph.intro: Every post is a dot and every subject a hub. A post links to what it is about, to the post it replied to, and to the posts it cites. Drag, zoom, and click a subject to rebuild the map around it.
graph.hint: Click a subject to see its posts; double-click to filter the map by it.
graph.truncated: Only the newest {count} posts of this period are drawn; narrow the range to see all of them.

archive.title: Posts
archive.emptyBody: Posts appear as soon as the channel history is imported.
